lines: Are these the only ones who made it this far?
I'm afraid so. They must greatly regret not being able to accompany you to the end.
They have demonstrated their loyalty. Set up watch and get some rest. We should have a little time.
Tokiko managed to stifle a mournful sigh that had been about to escape her.
By means of a do-or-die charge, they'd succeeded in breaking through the Igawa Ninja Force's encirclement and escaping from Fuma Village.
However, they had lost another half of their troops in the process. Now numbering less than 10, with even fewer who could properly fight.
They could no longer function as a proper fighting force anymore. Any conflicts with the enemy from this point on would prove difficult.
Having concealed themselves in a deserted house in the mountains, they were presently about 10 kilometers away from the village.
Tokiko-sama, where will we go from here?
There are more than a few who oppose the Igawa. For example, what if we were to turn to the Kokawa Clan for aid?
Tokiko shook her head in response to her subordinate's uneasy suggestion.
We are shinobi. There are none who would offer support to those without power.
Then what about the Kato Clan, who have been enemies with the Igawa for generations?
The Kato Clan have already made peace with the Igawa.
So those Kato Clan bastards just sat on the fence and watched!!!
The surviving Fuma, one and all, began to curse in frustration.
But Tokiko quietly reined them in.
No, they overcame their historic conflict through the persuasion of a certain person.
Yes, I think we should try turning to that person.
What kind of person could make peace between the Igawa and the Kato!?
I hear she's at odds with the elders of Igawa...
To-, Tokiko-sama, where is Igawa Asagi now?
Extreme unrest ran through those that had been watching Tokiko.
You can't mean for us to go all the way to Gosha, the headquarters of the Igawa Ninja Forces!?
Please rethink this!! It would be the same as going to our deaths!!
If anything, they'll turn you into their plaything, Tokiko-sama, and you'll experience a hell worse than death!
The Fuma shinobi were all slightly taken aback by Tokiko having made her assertion without hesitation.
The only way for the Fuma head family to survive is to negotiate with and gain the support of Igawa Asagi.
Rumor has it that she is the most powerful Taimanin and the next head of Igawa, but she is quite an eccentric person.
That's why she should be more inclined to talk to the Fuma now.
But I also hear she's the world's greatest simpleton.
That could also be a point of interest.
Tokiko turned to the young children who had been silently listening to the adults' conversation.
Master, you and I will now head to an extremely dangerous place. To the enemy's base.
I leave it up to you, Tokiko. We're going to meet this Igawa Asagi, right?
Kotaro had spoken in a firm tone.
Kotaro called out to Gaiza, who had been leaning against him and dozing off again.
Whu-, whuh is it, young lord?
A-As you wish! I, Gaiza, will be by your side, young lord!
Gaiza puffed out his chest, his eyes still droopy with sleep.
I'm counting on you all. Please just hold on a little longer for the sake of the Fuma.

"""By your will!!""
""By your will!!""
""By your will!!"""
The few Fuma Ninja bowed their heads in unison at the words of the young heads of the head family and the Nisha.
I will not force you into this journey into the lion's den. If there are any who wish to stay behind...
You must be joking, Tokiko-sama. No one wants to stay behind when things are about to get interesting.
We would come with you even if we were ordered not to, Tokiko-sama.
I can't believe we're actually heading for Gosha! I'm itching to put my skills to use!!!
Tokiko didn't have anything left to say...
